value.rationale: The closed-form full-parameter distribution of polygon types across the natural cube–octahedron continuum is a complete, geometrically motivated phase diagram, with explicit occurrence of decagons on both sides of a unique deterministic-octagon parameter and a sharp global maximum of expected section complexity. It goes materially beyond existing isolated special-parameter distributions, a local cusp, and the standard Crofton expectation.
